# Test that vendor mode package loading works in a workspace
# with nested modules.

go work vendor
go list -mod=vendor example.com/root/sub/p
stdout example.com/root/sub/p
go list -mod=vendor ./sub/p
stdout example.com/root/sub/p

-- go.work --
go 1.21

use (
	.
	./sub
)

-- go.mod --
module example.com/root

go 1.21

-- root.go --
package root

-- sub/go.mod --
module example.com/root/sub

go 1.21

require example.com/dep v0.0.0
replace example.com/dep => ./dep

-- sub/p/p.go --
package p

import _ "example.com/dep"

-- sub/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/dep

go 1.21

-- sub/dep/dep.go --
package dep
